name: How long does it take to complete an attached home addition?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to complete an attached home addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for an attached home addition depends on its scope, the complexity of the design, and the permitting process in your specific municipality. Smaller, simpler additions might take 4-6 months from design to completion, while larger or more intricate luxury additions can extend to 8-12 months or even longer. Permitting alone can take several weeks to months. A detailed project schedule will be provided after the design phase.
acceptedAnswer.description: Completion time varies by scope and design complexity, typically ranging from 4-12 months, with permitting being a significant factor.
